name: Pampanga Marathon 2026
short_description: Pampanga Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event held on September 13, 2026 at CDC Clark Parade Grounds, Angeles City / Clark, Pampanga, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Pampanga Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for September 13, 2026, at the CDC Clark Parade Grounds in Angeles City / Clark, Pampanga, Philippines. Organized by SMOKE10 Events, it offers multiple distance options including 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Held at a notable venue, CDC Clark Parade Grounds, in Pampanga
Organized by an established events company, SMOKE10 Events

research_highlights: The event is organized by SMOKE10 Events Management and has run annually at Clark Parade Grounds (CDC) in the Clark Freeport Zone since at least 2022, with prior editions in 2023, 2024 and 2025 under the same organizer.
Distances offered are 5K, 10K, 21K and 42K (some editions have also included a 16K), catering to both casual and serious runners.
The 2026 edition lists an early gun start around 4:30-4:45 AM, typical for Philippine road races to avoid daytime heat.
Race kit for the 2026 edition includes a race bib with RFID, singlet, medal, finisher shirt and drawstring bag, based on the official registration listing.

The race takes place in September, within the Philippine rainy/typhoon season, so runners should be prepared for possible wet weather based on historical patterns in Clark/Pampanga races held in this period.

faqs.question: Where is the Pampanga Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Pampanga Marathon 2026 takes place at the CDC Clark Parade Grounds, located in Angeles City / Clark, Pampanga, Philippines. This venue serves as the central location for the race, hosting all participants across the different distance categories offered during the event on September 13, 2026.

faqs.question: How can I register for the Pampanga Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for the Pampanga Marathon 2026 has not yet been announced. Interested participants should stay tuned for updates from the organizer, SMOKE10 Events, regarding when and how registration will open for this event scheduled for September 13, 2026.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Pampanga Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Pampanga Marathon 2026 offers four distance options for participants: a full marathon at 42.195km, a half marathon at 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This variety allows runners of different experience levels to participate in the event.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Pampanga Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Pampanga Marathon 2026 is organized by SMOKE10 Events, a company responsible for coordinating the race set to take place on September 13, 2026, at the CDC Clark Parade Grounds in Angeles City / Clark, Pampanga, Philippines.
